content: Command tables have 4 quoted columns: Cmd., Sub cmd., Data, Description. Rows with empty Cmd. are skipped during load (formatting artifacts). Don't dedupe by cmd alone — use (radio_id, cmd, sub_cmd).

title: 9700-csv-rename
rationale: Source repo used civ-command-table.csv for the 9700; renamed to civ-command-table-9700.csv here for consistency with other radios, and updated civ-radio-capabilities.json to match.

name: strip-manual-page-refs-at-load
description: Manual page references ('See p. N', 'See pp. N and M', 'See pp. N, M') in the CSV Data and Description columns are stripped at load time in store.py via _strip_page_refs(), never by editing the bundled data/ CSVs. Regex: See p+p?. [\d,\s]+(?:and \d+)?. They are Icom-manual artifacts not meaningful in the API/UI. Covers both leading-prefix and trailing forms. Also strips 'See pp. 18 and 19' multi-page form.

content: Radio capabilities must be verified against both CI-V CSV command evidence AND the Icom UK product pages (https://icomuk.co.uk/Amateur_Radio_Ham and sub-pages for each radio). The product pages don't list every detail, but anything that DIRECTLY CONTRADICTS the product pages is likely false and should be treated with high suspicion. Product pages are authoritative for hardware specs (type, power, modes, bands, architecture, display) and features not exposed via CI-V (HDMI, DVI-D, DPD, I/Q output, audio scope, FT8 preset, CW decoder, etc.). When a capability has no CI-V command but is confirmed on the product page, use command_evidence: 'Icom UK <model> product page'. When both CI-V and product page agree, cite both.

name: capability-types-and-evidence
description: The capabilities matrix (civ-radio-capabilities.json) contains three types of capability entries: (1) CI-V-backed — verified against CSV command tables, command_evidence cites specific hex commands; (2) Product-page-backed — hardware/UI features not exposed via CI-V, command_evidence cites 'Icom UK product page'; (3) Hardware-spec — string-valued specs (radio_type, tx_bands, rx_coverage, max_power, modes, receiver_architecture, display), command_evidence is 'Hardware specification'. The preamp capability was split into 'preamp' (internal, all radios true) and 'external_preamp' (9700 only, 4-value 0x16 0x02 encoding). The network_lan capability uses string values to specify what's available per radio (WLAN, Ethernet, false). Capabilities must be verified against both CSVs and product pages before adding or modifying.

title: capabilities-matrix-enhancement
rationale: Enhanced the radio capabilities matrix from 28 to 52 capabilities after a comprehensive review. Fixed 7 errors (7300 network_lan/ntp/dual_watch/qso_recorder, 7300mk2 dual_watch, 7100 touch_screen/sd_card) verified against CSV command evidence. Split external_preamp into preamp (internal, all 7 true) + external_preamp (9700 only). Broadened network_lan to use string values (WLAN/Ethernet/false). Added 7 CI-V-backed capabilities (vox, twin_peak_filter, digi_sel, wifi_bluetooth, psk_mode, contest_number, full_duplex), 10 product-page-backed capabilities (hdmi_output, cw_decoder, ft8_preset, dpd, dvi_d, iq_output, rx_antenna, audio_scope, satellite_tracking), and 7 hardware-spec capabilities (radio_type, tx_bands, rx_coverage, max_power, modes, receiver_architecture, display). External preamp for 7100 set to false — user-reported but no CI-V or product-page evidence found.

content: Every capability in civ-radio-capabilities.json has a human-friendly 'label' field (Title Case, e.g. 'D-STAR DV Mode', 'Twin PBT', 'DIGI-SEL') in addition to the machine-readable snake_case 'name'. The UI (app.js) displays label, falling back to name if label is empty. The Pydantic Capability model has label: str = Field('') so existing consumers without labels still work. Hardware spec capabilities (radio_type, tx_bands, rx_coverage, max_power, modes, receiver_architecture, display) are listed FIRST in the capabilities array, before all CI-V-backed and product-page capabilities, so they appear at the top of the capabilities table in the UI.

description: 7610 CSV carried IC-9700 parser artifacts: rows 0F 10/11/12 (simplex/DUP-/DUP+) and a 9700-value tuning-step row (10 00 to 11) contradict the IC-7610 CI-V manual (0F block lists only 0F 00/01 Split; 10* block is 00~08 with 9 kHz/25 kHz HF steps). The 7610 is HF/50MHz-only so DUP is meaningless.
resolution: Manual text is authoritative over code-usage reasoning: cross_check_report.md's 'keep 0F 10/11/12 because pycom uses them' mistook the same 9700-convention bug for evidence. Removed the 3 rows and corrected the tuning-step row; no capability evidence depends on 7610 0F 11 (attenuator is top-level 0x11). Verify per-radio CSV rows against the radio's own manual block, not sibling-radio conventions.

name: ic-7300-scope-waveform-framing-27-c39789
description: IC-7300 scope waveform framing (27 00) verified from IC-7300_ENG_FM_12atob.pdf p. 19-14: division max 11 (USB only, no LAN), data range 00~A0 (0~160), data length 475, 1st frame = wave information only, later frames = minimal wave info + waveform data. Key learning: the older IC-7300_ENG_FM_12b manual extract lacks the 'Command formats' section (27 00 defers to p. 19-14 which was not captured); checking a newer manual revision (12 atob) resolved feedback claims that previously rested on field-report evidence. Same framing family across 7300/7300mk2/705: length 475, 11 USB segments; 7760 differs (689/15 segments/704 LAN frame).

description: macOS Python urllib fails TLS verification when scripts/feedback_admin.py talks to https://icom-civ.stevendodd.net ('unable to get local issuer certificate') — Python's default context doesn't use the macOS keychain. Workaround with zero code change: export SSL_CERT_FILE=$(python3 -c 'import certifi; print(certifi.where())') before running the script. curl works unmodified (uses macOS trust store).
resolution: Added to triage workflow: run feedback_admin.py with SSL_CERT_FILE pointing at the installed certifi CA bundle; no repo change needed.

name: feedback-triage-verdict-for-capability-disputes-6e71db
description: Feedback triage verdict for capability disputes: the radio's own bundled command-table CSV wins over recollection/market knowledge, and product-page evidence outranks intuition too. Example: IC-7610 rx_antenna was assumed hardware-impossible but the 7610 CSV contains 0x12 00/01 (ANT1/ANT2 RX ANT OFF/ON) and 0x1A 05 0275 (TYPE SET > RX-ANT Connectors) — menus don't ship for nonexistent hardware, so false→true flip was justified. Check <radio>_verification_report.md for already-logged rows before concluding evidence is thin. Note: 7300mk2 rx_antenna=true rests on product-page evidence alone (no CSV rows)

Icom UK product pages cannot be fetched programmatically: categoryRender.asp?categoryID=...&productID=... URLs return HTTP 301->'Invalid category' error page for curl and webfetch regardless of User-Agent/Referer/cookie jar, and guessed SEO paths (/IC-7610, /IC-7610/2/587/) 404 or serve unrelated content. Product-page verification during capability triage is therefore only possible by reading the page in a browser; rely on bundled CSV/manual evidence instead.
resolution: Treat CSV command evidence + CI-V manual text as the authoritative verification sources; when a product-page check is truly required, open the page manually in a browser at icomuk.co.uk.

title: 7300 collision re-key (triage 2026-10-17): DATA mode and IP+ moved from colla...
rationale: 7300 collision re-key (triage 2026-10-17): DATA mode and IP+ moved from collapsed keys 05,0006/05,0007 to top-level 1A/06 and 1A/07 — NOT the 3-token '05,00,06' keys the feedback submitter proposed. Rationale: all 5 other radios key them as plain '1A','06'/'07' and manual IC-7300_ENG_FM_12b lines 429-430 show them as top-level 1A subs after the 1A 05 02 xx families. 2-byte '00 06'/'00 07' tone-control subs stay at 4-hex 05,0006/05,0007 (7300 manual L183-186). Related: 705 value-range-in-desc rows ('00/01 Send/read...') kept the item token in data and stripped only the desc prefix, matching the 7100's identical family; the feedback's suggested data='00/01' would have collided the two 24/00 rows.

name: 7760-csv-out-of-scope-observations-2ae899
description: 7760 CSV out-of-scope observations from 2026-10-17 triage (fix candidates for a future pass): (1) 1A single-byte subs 06-0A are missing entirely (manual 7760 lines 556-560: 06=DATA mode, 07=NTP server access, 08=NTP result, 09=AF Mute, 0A=OVF indicator; also '05 06' DATA mode per manual line 557); (2) rows '12','','Start a Fine programmed scan' and '13','','Start a Fine dF scan' (CSV lines ~70-71) have sub/data/desc misaligned; (3) 7300mk2 row 05,0144 has data cell literally 'See p. 22' — real data values lost in transcription, desc 'Waveform Color (Current)' (mk2 manual needed); (4) 7760 manual's 29 00 or 01 row is the '+ Supported commands' MAIN/SUB prefix convention (raw manual ~line 2614: 'The supported commands are marked by 29 in the command table') — the CSV's clean paraphrased '29' row at the file tail is the genuine representation, the 27/29 flat copy was deleted.

Page-ref strip regex gaps (fed triage 2026-10-17): _SEE_PAGE_RE consumed 'see p. 20' of hyphenated ranges, leaving '-11' debris (7100: 50 rows), and never matched bare leading 'p. 19-9 ' desc prefixes (7300: 108 rows) because it required 'See'. CAUTION: making the bare pattern unanchored eats legit mid-string prose like 705 27/00 '(per manual p. 28)' — bare prefixes must be stripped at field start only (separate ^-anchored regex).
resolution: Regex rework in commit bb77654 + full-store before/after diff verification

content: Standing policy (Steve): when a manual-vs-CSV check surfaces missing, mis-keyed, or phantom rows, report them in the session summary AND correct them immediately in the same session — 'we don't want to hold back for the next pass'. Only defer when meaning is genuinely ambiguous (or needs hardware/Icom-errata verification, e.g. manual-printed numbering typos). Verification bar: verbatim manual line citation + (where possible) cross-radio CSV precedent within the same command family.

name: coverage-audit-technique-that-surfaced-the-5dccbf
description: Coverage-audit technique that surfaced the 2026-10-17 second batch: (1) cmd-level: grep manuals for 'NN*' block headers, compare against the CSV's distinct cmd values — expect false positives where sub-rows share header formatting (07/0E/0F families carry B0-B3/C0-C2/D0-D3 + numeric 10-13 sub-rows that regex as headers); (2) sub-level: walk each manual's block and compare against CSV keys — this caught the 7760 1C block carrying cmd-1E content (transcriber error), which the cross-radio 7610 CSV precedent exposed immediately. 2026-10-17 second batch closure (commit 9d25705): 7760 1A/06-0A added (DATA mode, NTP access/result, AF Mute, OVF), 1C block rebuilt, 1E re-keyed, 0F re-keyed, UDP ports 0179-0181 rebuilt from BCD-wrapped manual lines, phantoms deleted (07/00 VFO A, 1A/BE, 05,0503, 05,0655, 05,0929, 1A/01 TSQL dup); 9700 0F-block duplicates of cmds 10/11 deleted + 11/10 attenuator row data shift fixed. Also RESOLVES the earlier out-of-scope observations record: mk2 05,0144 data cell 'See p. 22' is correct as-is (the mk2 manual genuinely prints no inline values for Waveform Color rows; loader strips it), and the 7760 12/13 'scan' rows were 0E duplicates now deleted. Capabilities: attenuator command_evidence updated ('0F 11' clause was grounded in those deleted duplicates).
